name: Band Pulse
description: Pulses only the band between Low and High, up to 40 times a second, with a set Duty and Edge. The tremolo moves the whole sound; this leaves bass and air steady.

params.name: Rate
params.description: How many pulses a second. Slow is a swell that comes and goes, the middle is a flutter, and the top is a rough hum on the band.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far the band drops between pulses. At full the gaps are silent. At zero nothing is pulsed and every part of the sound passes at its own level.

params.name: Duty
params.description: How much of each cycle the pulse is on. Low gives short ticks with long gaps, high gives short dips in a steady sound.

params.name: Edge
params.description: How long a pulse takes to rise and to fall. Short is a hard chop, long is a soft swell. It is held to half of the shorter of the on time and the gap.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Moves the right side's pulse behind the left's. At 180 with Duty at half the sides take turns, and in mono, or in a reverb fed from both sides, the pulse is gone.

params.name: Low
params.description: The bottom of the band that is pulsed. Sound under it keeps its own level, so the bass stays steady.

params.name: High
params.description: The top of the band that is pulsed. Sound over it keeps its own level. The top stays at least half an octave over Low.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit, with the pulse of cpp/kit/beat.h and the split of cpp/kit/band.h. An even pulse on the middle band of a sound; no unit or plug-in is modelled.
